plain: Great killing, a bloody slaughter of many people

webster.text: Literally, flesh, or heaps of flesh, as in shambles.

more.text: Slaughter; great destruction of men; havock; massacre.

example.quote: They either fail to execute their commissions, or they do it with all the devastation and carnage of civil war.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 19 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 8, 1787
